_readme.storeDir: Configure the IDEMPOTENCY_STORE_DIR n8n variable to a persistent directory shared across all n8n worker instances (e.g. a mounted volume). Default: /data/n8n/idempotency
_readme.ttl: Records older than 30 days are automatically swept. GitHub redelivery window is 72 h.
_readme.atomicity: The gate uses O_EXCL (exclusive-create) so exactly one concurrent execution claims each key.
_readme.e2e_proof: To verify: generate a new GitHub delivery, note the X-GitHub-Delivery ID, deliberately redeliver via GitHub webhook settings, and confirm exactly one ClickUp comment appears.
